title: Publish: a signed Alpine repository
note: For postmarketOS phones: APKBUILD built for aarch64, signed, published.  2026-11-17: alpine.yml - the APKBUILD built from the tag in an Alpine container (an arm64 runner for aarch64) without the key, packaged and indexed with abuild in a fresh container that alone gets APK_SIGNING_KEY (checked against the committed public half), every package and index verified with apk before the pages deploy, then the page own lines run in a clean Alpine container and the package installed at the tagged version. First user: linux-phone-oco/lab-tools (devlab-health, postmarketOS v26.06 / Alpine 3.24).  Proven 2026-11-17 by its first user, linux-phone-oco/lab-tools: devlab-health 0.1.0 built for aarch64, signed, every package and index verified, published to linux-phone-oco.github.io/lab-tools, then installed in a clean Alpine 3.24 from the page own lines at 0.1.0-r0 (lab-tools run 44016089315). Released as v1.1.3 (v1 moved).  2026-11-18: several packages in one repository (v1.2.0), the packaging container with the makedepends (v1.2.1): see decision 2026-11-18-one-repository-many-packages.

title: Publish: a signed pacman repository
note: publish.yml: the Arch package built from the release's PKGBUILD, the repository signed, its page written, deployed only when every signature verifies, then installed from the README's snippet in a fresh container.

title: The declaration and its check
note: packaging/conveyor.toml, read by every job before anything runs; a missing field fails the plan.

title: The design, written
note: Its idea, decisions with what was rejected, and its path, from the delivery machinery of snapall and lab-agent.

title: Machines that actually receive updates
note: The lab machine updates lab-agent daily by a timer (grenudi/lab-machine). The phone, and other machines, still to do. Settled 2026-11-11: the lab machine updates daily; next: the phone.

title: lab-agent on the conveyor
note: lab-agent v0.1.47 was the conveyor's first delivery (2026-11-11): every job green, the real install passed; 187 lines of copied workflow became a 20-line declaration.

title: snapall on the conveyor
note: Its published repositories identical before and after.

title: A passing mirror outage must not fail a release
note: lab-agent v0.1.51 (2026-11-11): both binary builds failed because the CI machines could not resolve Ubuntu's mirrors while installing musl-tools. Retry the install with backoff, or need no apt at all (a musl toolchain that comes with the Rust toolchain).

title: Build in the project's own Nix environment
note: binaries.yml installs Nix and builds inside the project's shell.nix (musl toolchain pinned there); no apt; the same environment as the lab machine.

title: Release: binaries with signed provenance
note: binaries.yml: two architectures, deb and rpm, signed provenance, attached to the release; the PKGBUILD filled in.

title: The phone's shell shipped through it
note: 2026-11-18: sxmo-utils (lab-tools, 1.18.1_p20261118, source tag lab-20261118.1 of grenudi/sxmo-utils, every subpackage) built by alpine.yml v1.2.1 for aarch64, signed, published beside lpoco-health on https://linux-phone-oco.github.io/lab-tools/ and installed in a clean Alpine 3.24 from the page's own lines (lab-tools Packages run 44322521483); rebuilding lpoco-health kept all 18 sxmo-utils files (run 44322907826). Open: installed on the phone as sxmo-utils@lab, its health checks passing.

title: A typed reader for the declaration
note: A small Rust tool in this repository reads packaging/conveyor.toml into typed structures (unknown fields refused, required ones named) and gives each job what it needs; the workflows run it at their own version instead of inline Python.

title: Verify: installed on six systems
note: The six-system installation matrix (snapall's release-verify) is not extracted yet; publish.yml installs on Arch only.

title: The apk page names each package's licence, origin and exact source
note: 2026-11-19: v1.2.2 (PR 22): per package, licence, project url and version from the signed index, origin from the APKBUILD's '# Origin:' line, source from its source= as abuild expands it and the APKBUILD folder at the release tag; kept per package in origins/NAME.json; a live package without a record says not recorded. Proven by tests/alpine/run.sh (failed first: no section for fixt-one) and on https://linux-phone-oco.github.io/lab-tools/ (lpoco-health: MIT OR Apache-2.0, source tag lpoco-health-v0.24.0). See decision 2026-11-19-page-names-licence-origin-source.

title: A package can be retired from the pages on purpose
note: 2026-11-19: v1.2.2 (PR 23): [alpine] retire = [names] in the declaration; v1.2.3 (PR 24): also a retire input of the call, because the declaration is read at the release tag. Proven by tests/alpine/run.sh and by lab-tools' packages run 44466561032 (retire=sxmo-utils): the live page and index list lpoco-health only, the sxmo-utils apk and its record answer 404. Decisions 2026-11-19-retire-a-package and 2026-11-19-retire-in-the-call-too.
